commands.name: bookmarks-dialog
commands.code: async function main(argv, ctx) { const terms = argv.positionals.map((value) => String(value).trim()).filter(Boolean); if (terms.length === 0) { ctx.out.warn('Provide at least one URL substring to search for.'); ctx.out.write('Usage: f bookmarks-dialog <word...>'); return { matched: 0, deleted: 0 }; } const needles = terms.map((term) => term.toLowerCase()); const roots = await ctx.chrome.bookmarks.getTree(); const bookmarks = []; const visit = (node) => { if (!node) { return; } if (node.url) { bookmarks.push(node); } for (const child of node.children || []) { visit(child); } }; for (const root of roots || []) { visit(root); } const matches = bookmarks.filter((bookmark) => { const url = String(bookmark.url || '').toLowerCase(); return needles.some((needle) => url.includes(needle)); }).map((bookmark) => ({ id: bookmark.id, title: bookmark.title || '(untitled)', url: bookmark.url })); ctx.out.info('Matched ' + matches.length + ' bookmark(s) for: ' + terms.join(', ')); if (matches.length === 0) { return { matched: 0, deleted: 0 }; } await ctx.main.define('chooseBookmarksToDelete', (matchesForDialog, searchTerms) => new Promise((resolve) => { const old = document.getElementById('factotum-bookmarks-dialog-example'); if (old) { old.remove(); } const root = document.createElement('div'); root.id = 'factotum-bookmarks-dialog-example'; Object.assign(root.style, { position: 'fixed', inset: '0', zIndex: '2147483647', background: 'rgba(10, 14, 18, 0.55)', display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', fontFamily: 'ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif' }); const shadow = root.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' }); const style = document.createElement('style'); style.textContent = ':host{all:initial}*{box-sizing:border-box}button, input{font:inherit}button{appearance:none;border:0;background:none;color:inherit}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0ea5e9;outline-offset:2px} .panel{width:min(920px,92vw);max-height:80vh;overflow:auto;background:#fffaf0;color:#16130d;border:1px solid #2d2616;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding:20px}.title{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;line-height:1.2}.summary{margin:0 0 16px}.list{display:grid;gap:10px;margin:0 0 18px}.item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:start;border:1px solid #d8c9a7;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;background:#fff}.check{appearance:auto;display:inline-block;inline-size:18px;block-size:18px;margin-top:3px;accent-color:#16130d}.item-text strong{display:block}.item-url{display:block;margin-top:4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#5b4b24}.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end}.action{border:1px solid #2d2616;border-radius:999px;background:#16130d;color:#fffaf0;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer}.action.secondary{background:#fffaf0;color:#16130d}'; const panel = document.createElement('section'); panel.className = 'panel'; const title = document.createElement('h2'); title.className = 'title'; title.textContent = 'Delete matching bookmarks'; const summary = document.createElement('p'); summary.className = 'summary'; summary.textContent = 'Matches for: ' + searchTerms.join(', ') + '. Select bookmarks to delete.'; const list = document.createElement('div'); list.className = 'list'; for (const match of matchesForDialog) { const label = document.createElement('label'); label.className = 'item'; const checkbox = document.createElement('input'); checkbox.className = 'check'; checkbox.type = 'checkbox'; checkbox.value = match.id; const text = document.createElement('span'); text.className = 'item-text'; const strong = document.createElement('strong'); strong.textContent = match.title; const url = document.createElement('span'); url.className = 'item-url'; url.textContent = match.url; text.append(strong, url); label.append(checkbox, text); list.append(label); } const actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'actions'; const makeButton = (text, secondary = false) => { const button = document.createElement('button'); button.type = 'button'; button.className = secondary ? 'action secondary' : 'action'; button.textContent = text; return button; }; const all = makeButton('All', true); const none = makeButton('None', true); const cancel = makeButton('Cancel', true); const del = makeButton('Delete selected'); const cleanup = (payload) => { root.remove(); resolve(payload); }; all.addEventListener('click', () => { for (const box of list.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]')) { box.checked = true; } }); none.addEventListener('click', () => { for (const box of list.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]')) { box.checked = false; } }); cancel.addEventListener('click', () => cleanup({ action: 'cancel', ids: [] })); del.addEventListener('click', () => cleanup({ action: 'delete', ids: Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]:checked')).map((box) => box.value) })); actions.append(all, none, cancel, del); panel.append(title, summary, list, actions); shadow.append(style, panel); document.documentElement.append(root); })); const choice = await ctx.main.call('chooseBookmarksToDelete', [matches, terms]); if (!choice || choice.action !== 'delete') { ctx.out.info('Canceled. No bookmarks deleted.'); return { matched: matches.length, deleted: 0 }; } const selectedIds = new Set(Array.isArray(choice.ids) ? choice.ids : []); const selected = matches.filter((match) => selectedIds.has(match.id)); if (selected.length === 0) { ctx.out.warn('No bookmarks selected. No bookmarks deleted.'); return { matched: matches.length, deleted: 0 }; } ctx.out.info('Deleting ' + selected.length + ' of ' + matches.length + ' matched bookmark(s).'); for (const match of selected) { ctx.out.write(match.title + '\n' + match.url); } let deleted = 0; for (const match of selected) { try { await ctx.chrome.bookmarks.remove(match.id); deleted += 1; } catch (error) { ctx.out.error('Failed to delete ' + (match.title || match.url) + ': ' + (error.message || String(error))); } } ctx.out.info('Deleted ' + deleted + ' bookmark(s).'); return { matched: matches.length, deleted }; }

en-US.title: bookmarks-dialog
en-US.summary: Find bookmarks by URL substring, show matches in a page modal, and delete only the checked selections.
